description: One-replica, 20-minute EdgeBench VLIW smoke using Claude Code with GLM-5.2 and deep thinking disabled.

protocol_override_reasons.agent: the smoke selects the native Claude Code agent through the Z.AI Anthropic-compatible API
protocol_override_reasons.backend: the local smoke uses Docker instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the smoke evaluates the selected GLM-5.2 development model
protocol_override_reasons.reasoning_effort: deep thinking is disabled and reasoning effort none is pinned explicitly for reproducibility
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the lifecycle smoke uses a twenty-minute task budget
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: the smoke uses one trajectory rather than three paper trajectories
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the local controller runs one task-method cell at a time
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
